jumpCarryReach.description: Tavan hesabinda kalkis + inis kenar payi (m, ~kapsul capi). Buyuk = daha guvenli, daha az hiz korunur.

roomName.title: Room Name
roomName.description: Server room of this world (also the accessToken). World 2: skateboardObby2.

sceneName.title: Scene Name
sceneName.description: Scene reloaded by Create Room / Join Room.

saveSuffix.title: Save Suffix
saveSuffix.description: Added to the checkpoint save key so each world keeps its own progress. World 1 empty, World 2 _W2. Coins, shop, VIP and quests stay shared.

boostPowerupDuration.title: Boost Power-up Duration (sn)
boostPowerupDuration.description: Boost power-up'i (1 reklam) Boost'u bu kadar sure acar. Olunce / respawn'da devam eder

rollingFriction.title: Rolling Friction
rollingFriction.description: Speed lost per second while coasting

overspeedDeceleration.title: Overspeed Deceleration
overspeedDeceleration.description: How fast speed falls back to max after a boost

slopeGravity.title: Slope Gravity
slopeGravity.description: Speed gained going downhill / lost going uphill

turnSpeedLow.title: Turn Speed (slow)
turnSpeedLow.description: deg/s when slow - turning gets wider as speed goes up

airControl.title: Air Turn Control
airControl.description: Turn speed in the air compared to the ground (1 = same)

cameraFollow.title: Camera Auto Follow
cameraFollow.description: How fast the camera swings behind the board (0 = off, the player steers with the camera)

deathHeight.title: Death Height
deathHeight.description: Going below this Y starts the fall animation, then the character shatters (the only fall check)

sideTurnMultiplier.title: A/D Turn Multiplier
sideTurnMultiplier.description: Extra turn speed while A/D (joystick sideways) is held

carveSpeedLoss.title: Carve Speed Loss
carveSpeedLoss.description: Speed lost per second in sharp turns

quickTurnAngle.title: Quick Turn Angle
quickTurnAngle.description: If the wanted direction is more than this many degrees away, the board kick-turns fast

quickTurnSpeedLoss.title: Quick Turn Speed Loss
quickTurnSpeedLoss.description: Fraction of speed lost per second while kick-turning

airSteer.title: Air Steer
airSteer.description: How fast the movement direction follows the board in the air (higher = more control)

airAcceleration.title: Air Acceleration
airAcceleration.description: Lets you drift forward in the air, e.g. after a standing jump

airMaxSpeed.title: Air Max Speed
airMaxSpeed.description: Air acceleration only works below this speed

fallAnimTime.title: Fall Anim Time
fallAnimTime.description: Seconds of Ch_Fall before the character shatters

skidMinSpeed.title: Skid Min Speed
skidMinSpeed.description: Skid marks appear above this speed

skidTurnRate.title: Skid Turn Rate
skidTurnRate.description: Turning faster than this (deg/s) leaves skid marks

skidLife.title: Skid Mark Life
skidLife.description: Seconds before a skid mark fades out

slipperyTurn.title: Slippery: Steering
slipperyTurn.description: Turn speed on a slippery puddle (1 = normal)

slipperyPush.title: Slippery: Push
slipperyPush.description: Push power on a slippery puddle (1 = normal)

stickyDecel.title: Sticky: Slow Down
stickyDecel.description: How fast the goo takes the speed away (units/s per s)

stickyJump.title: Sticky: Ollie Power
stickyJump.description: Ollie power in the goo (1 = normal)

grindFriction.title: Grind: Friction
grindFriction.description: Speed lost per second on the rail

loopGravity.title: Loop: Gravity
loopGravity.description: Speed lost going up the loop (higher = needs more entry speed)

loopMinSpeed.title: Loop: Min Speed
loopMinSpeed.description: Below this speed in the loop the board slides back down

leanAngle.title: Extra Code Lean
leanAngle.description: Extra lean added by code on top of the Turn animations (0 = off, the animations do the lean)

turnAnimRate.title: Turn Anim Rate
turnAnimRate.description: Turning faster than this (deg/s) switches from Push to the Carve blend (Move <-> Turn_L / Turn_R); stops below half of it

turnFullRate.title: Turn Full Lean Rate
turnFullRate.description: Turn rate (deg/s) that plays the full Turn_L / Turn_R pose; slower turns blend it with Move

sideLean.title: A/D Lean
sideLean.description: Carve lean while A/D (joystick sideways) is held, 0..1 (1 = full Turn_L / Turn_R pose)

respawnGuardTime.title: Respawn Guard
respawnGuardTime.description: Seconds after a respawn in which deaths other than falling below Death Height (R / Reset, playerDie events) are ignored. Safety net only, it never blocks a real fall

maxGroundAngle.title: Max Ground Angle
maxGroundAngle.description: Surfaces steeper than this (degrees) are not ground: the board does not stick to walls / side faces. The loop is excluded

uphillGravity.title: Uphill Gravity
uphillGravity.description: Speed lost going uphill (Slope Gravity is used downhill and when rolling back). 9.8 = real gravity

rollBack.title: Roll Back On Slopes
rollBack.description: When the speed runs out on a slope the board rolls back down (fakie) instead of sticking to it

impactIgnoresRedirect.title: Impact: Ignore Redirect
impactIgnoresRedirect.description: On the ground only a real loss of speed (a wall) slows the board; the direction change on curved ramps and mesh seams does not

lowSpeedGravity.title: Low Speed Air Gravity
lowSpeedGravity.description: Extra Gravity multiplier at speed 0 (1 at Max Speed): slow jumps and drops float a bit longer

constantOllieHeight.title: Constant Ollie Height
constantOllieHeight.description: The ollie reaches the same height at every speed (Ollie Power is the take-off speed at Max Speed)

flatHover.title: Flat Ground Hover
flatHover.description: On (nearly) flat ground the capsule floats just above the surface instead of being pressed into it, so collider seams cannot kick it up (road jitter). Slopes keep the normal glue

rideHeight.title: Hover: Height
rideHeight.description: Capsule center height over flat ground (x player scale). 1.0 = touching; below ~1.02 the seams kick again

flatHoverMaxSlope.title: Hover: Max Slope
flatHoverMaxSlope.description: Ground steeper than this (degrees) uses the normal glue

flatHoverTime.title: Hover: Response Time
flatHoverTime.description: Seconds to reach the hover height

hoverKeepsBoardDown.title: Hover: Keep Board Down
hoverKeepsBoardDown.description: While hovering, the visual Body is lowered by the hover gap so the wheels stay on the ground

vertAir.title: Vert Air
vertAir.description: Riding up a quarter pipe / bowl / halfpipe wall launches the board straight up past the coping and back into the same ramp (no flying onto the deck or into the wall)

vertMinSpeed.title: Vert: Min Speed
vertMinSpeed.description: Slower than this the board only goes up the wall and rolls back (fakie), no extra height / trick / turn

vertMinAngle.title: Vert: Min Wall Angle
vertMinAngle.description: The ramp the board leaves must be at least this steep (deg)

vertHeight.title: Vert: Height
vertHeight.description: Take-off speed straight up = board speed x this (the height grows with speed squared)

vertGravity.title: Vert: Air Gravity
vertGravity.description: Extra Gravity multiplier during a vert air (lower = more hang time)

vertDriftIn.title: Vert: Drift In
vertDriftIn.description: Speed back into the ramp during the air (m/s), so the board lands on the ramp, not on the coping

vertKeepAlong.title: Vert: Keep Along Coping
vertKeepAlong.description: How much of the speed along the coping is kept (less if the landing would be on the deck, e.g. in a round bowl)

vertTurnAround.title: Vert: Turn Around
vertTurnAround.description: The board turns in the air to face down the ramp (mirrored off the wall), so it lands riding forward

vertTricks.title: Vert: Tricks
vertTricks.description: Anim states played in the air, one at random (comma separated; 'all' = the ollie trick pool; empty = InAir)

vertWallCheck.title: Vert: Wall Check
vertWallCheck.description: Distance (m) the wall must go on above the take-off point; a kicker / launch ramp lip has nothing there and is not a vert

groundLookAhead.title: Ground: Look Ahead
groundLookAhead.description: Riding onto a ramp / steeper surface, the board is lifted to where that surface will be next frame (otherwise the capsule can dip into the thin start of a ramp mesh and physics pushes it through)

groundAntiSink.title: Ground: Anti Sink
groundAntiSink.description: A board that has sunk into the ground under it (riding, on the ollie or landing) is put back on top

vertFakieAngle.title: Vert: Fakie Angle
vertFakieAngle.description: Straight-on airs (the board would turn more than this, deg) land fakie without turning; at an angle the board turns. The camera is never turned

sweptGuard.title: Ground: Swept Landing
sweptGuard.description: In the air the motion is checked ahead with a ray, so a fast landing cannot take the capsule through a thin ground collider (single-sheet slope)

vertAirControl.title: Vert: Air Control
vertAirControl.description: Steering in a vert air with W/A/S/D / the joystick (camera-relative), m/s per second; 0 = off

vertAirControlMax.title: Vert: Air Control Max
vertAirControlMax.description: The most speed (m/s) the air control adds to the flight

vertExit.title: Vert: Exit To Deck
vertExit.description: Pushing out over the coping once the board is above the wall leaves the bowl / halfpipe and lands on the deck

vertExitSpeed.title: Vert: Exit Max Speed
vertExitSpeed.description: Most speed (m/s) out over the coping; a deck that needs more is not reached and the board stays in the ramp

vertOverTag.title: Vert: Over Tag
vertOverTag.description: Collider tag of free-standing ramps: no vert air on them, the board jumps off them and lands on the ground ahead

vertOverLand.title: Vert: Over Landing
vertOverLand.description: A jump lands at least this many metres past the start of the ground

vertOverMargin.title: Vert: Over Margin
vertOverMargin.description: A jump lands at least this many metres before the ground ends

vertOverPop.title: Vert: Over Pop
vertOverPop.description: A hop too slow to jump across goes up this part of the board speed

vertOverAngle.title: Vert: Over Angle
vertOverAngle.description: The take-off angle of a jump off a free-standing ramp, when that lands on flat ground

vertOverMaxAngle.title: Vert: Over Max Angle
vertOverMaxAngle.description: Steepest take-off to reach the ground across a gap; slower boards that would need more do not try

vertOverMinAngle.title: Vert: Over Min Angle
vertOverMinAngle.description: Flattest take-off to stay on the ground before a gap

vertOverRange.title: Vert: Over Range
vertOverRange.description: How far ahead (m) a jump off a free-standing ramp looks for ground

vertOverAssist.title: Vert: Over Assist
vertOverAssist.description: A board just short of the ground across a gap gets up to this times its speed for the jump

hoverRampMaxSlope.title: Hover: Ramp Max Slope
hoverRampMaxSlope.description: The hover also rides ramps up to this steep: pressed into a faceted curve the board hits every kink of its collider. 0 = flat ground only

loopDrift.title: Loop Side Drift (local)
loopDrift.description: How far the track moves sideways (local X) over one turn

height.title: Height
height.description: Beam height from the entity position upwards (world units). The top fades out.

coreRadius.title: Core Radius
coreRadius.description: Radius of the solid bright core.

glowWidth.title: Glow Width
glowWidth.description: How far the soft glow reaches past the core edge (world units).

intensity.title: Intensity
intensity.description: Brightness of the core and the glow.

pulseSpeed.title: Pulse Speed
pulseSpeed.description: Slow brightness pulse (0.85 - 1.0), pulses per second. 0 = off.

scrollSpeed.title: Scroll Speed
scrollSpeed.description: Glow streaks moving up the beam (world units per second). 0 = off, negative = down.

fadeDistance.title: Near Fade Distance
fadeDistance.description: When the camera gets closer than this to the beam axis, the pillar fades away (fully gone at 1/3 of it), so riding through it does not fill the screen. 0 = off.

glowOpacity.title: Glow Cover
glowOpacity.description: 0 = pure additive glow (best on dark scenes). Higher = the glow also covers the background a little, so the colour stays visible on a bright sky. Same cost.

track.title: Track
track.description: Bar image; Ticks and Heads use the same horizontal span

countText.title: Percent Text
countText.description: Text inside the bar, shows the local progress in %

timerSlot.title: Timer Slot
timerSlot.description: Space reserved for the speedrun timer; the bar is placed below it

avoid.title: Avoid
avoid.description: UI groups the bar must not overlap (LeftCorner, RightCorner)

gap.title: Gap
gap.description: Space below the timer slot and next to avoided elements (screen units)

pillWidth.title: Poki Pill Area Width (CSS px)
pillWidth.description: Touch devices only: top-left area kept free for the Poki pill (62 px wide + margin)

pillHeight.title: Poki Pill Area Height (CSS px)
pillHeight.description: From the top of the screen: 24 px offset + 46 px pill + margin

useDistance.title: In-between Progress
useDistance.description: Move between checkpoints by distance (off = only jumps when a checkpoint is taken)

maxBetween.title: Max In-between
maxBetween.description: Fraction of a step the head can move before the next checkpoint is taken

barInsetLeft.title: Bar Inset Left
barInsetLeft.description: Transparent left edge of the bar texture, as a fraction of its width (9 / 512)

barInsetRight.title: Bar Inset Right
barInsetRight.description: Transparent right edge of the bar texture, as a fraction of its width (10 / 512)

glowWidth.title: Glow Width
glowWidth.description: How far the glow reaches out from the object surface (world units).

pulseSpeed.title: Pulse Speed
pulseSpeed.description: Slow brightness pulse (0.8 - 1.0), pulses per second. 0 = off.

glowOpacity.title: Glow Cover
glowOpacity.description: 0 = pure additive glow (best on dark scenes). Higher = the glow also dims the background a little, so the colour stays visible on a bright sky.

cause.title: Death Cause
cause.description: Text for the console death log. Empty = "touched <entity name>".

rewardWins.title: Reward Wins
rewardWins.description: Trophies the end portal of that world gives (shown on the portal). 0 = hide.

requiredLevel.title: Required Level
requiredLevel.description: Sadece ilk acilis icin. Bir kez acilinca kalici.

requiredRebirth.title: Required Rebirth
requiredRebirth.description: Sadece ilk acilis icin. Bir kez acilinca kalici.

isWorld2Gate.title: World 2 Gate
isWorld2Gate.description: Write the requirement into gameManager.balance.world2Level / world2Rebirth.

unlockSaveKey.title: Unlock Save Key
unlockSaveKey.description: Sart bir kez saglaninca bu anahtarla kaydedilir; sonra level / rebirth ne olursa olsun portal hep acik. Bos = kalici acilma yok.

opensWorldsPanel.title: Opens Worlds Panel
opensWorldsPanel.description: Walking in only opens the Worlds panel (world select). No teleport popup or lock warning; the label shows Panel Label. Off = old direct portal to Scene Name.

panelLabel.title: Panel Label
panelLabel.description: Text on the portal while it opens the Worlds panel.

spendWins.title: Spend Wins
spendWins.description: Acik: kupa harcanir. Kapali: sadece kupa sarti.

trigger.description: Muz standi (monkeyObbyTrigger): girince shop Skin sekmesinde acilir

skinSpendWins.title: Skin Spend Wins
skinSpendWins.description: Kapali (eski skin shop gibi): kupa sadece sart. Acik: skin icin kupa harcanir.

desktopShaderTrail.title: Shader Trail (PC)
desktopShaderTrail.description: Bilgisayarda kendi oyuncunun trail i shader li egilen serit olur. Mobilde her zaman basit trail.

adChain.title: Ad Chain
adChain.description: Trail ve Aura sekmelerinde reklamli item, ayni sekmedeki bir onceki reklamli item alinmadan kilitli. Skin sekmesinde zincir yok.

lockIcon.description: Zincirde kilitli reklamli item butonundaki ikon

material.title: Material
material.description: Derin deniz malzemesi (yakin denizle ayni olmali).

size.title: Size (m)
size.description: Kenar uzunlugu. Kamera farClip * 2 + biraz pay.

height.title: Water Y
height.description: Yakin denizin dalga cukurlarinin (-1.2) altinda kalmali.

direction.title: Arrow Direction (local)
direction.description: Oklarin yonu. Oyuncu duvara yonsuz gelirse bu yone kosar.

useRunSpeed.title: Use Run Speed If Faster
useRunSpeed.description: Oyuncunun kendi kosu hizi daha yuksekse W ile o hizda kosar.

launchSpeed.title: Entry Speed
launchSpeed.description: Duvara oturunca en az bu hizla ileri gider.

slideSlow.title: Slide Down (no W)
slideSlow.description: W basili degilken sabit asagi kayma hizi (m/s).

normal.title: Face Normal (local)
normal.description: Kutunun yola bakan yuzu (yerel eksen). Sol panel +X, sag panel -X.

magnetDistance.title: Grab Distance
magnetDistance.description: Panele dogru ziplarken bu mesafeden duvara cekilir.

exitForwardMax.title: End Hop Forward (max)
exitForwardMax.description: Panel sonundaki ziplamanin en fazla ileri hizi.

runAnimRef.title: Run Anim Ref Speed
runAnimRef.description: Kosu animasyonu bu hizda normal oynar; daha hizliyken hizlanir.

exitForwardMin.title: End Hop Forward (min)
exitForwardMin.description: Panel sonundaki ziplamanin en az ileri hizi (yavas kosarken de karsiya gecebilsin). 0 = yok.

showHint.title: Show Hint
showHint.description: Duvarda W basili degilken ekranin altinda ipucu.

schema.name: unlockSaveKey
schema.title: Unlock Save Key
schema.description: Saved once the requirement is met; the world then stays open. MonkeyObby_World2Unlocked = use the GameManager World 2 gate.

schema.name: roomName
schema.title: Room Name
schema.description: Server room of this world (its NetworkManager roomName) for the online counter. Empty = no counter.

maxVisibleCards.title: Max Visible Cards
maxVisibleCards.description: More worlds than this scroll (the half card shows there is more).

fitMargin.title: Fit Margin
fitMargin.description: Part of the screen height the panel may use.

photoPreloadDelay.title: Photo Preload Delay (s)
photoPreloadDelay.description: Photos start loading this long after the scene starts. -1 = only when the panel opens.

hereSprite.title: HERE Button Sprite
hereSprite.description: Button of the world you are in (game blue button). GO uses the template GoButton sprite.

lockedSprite.title: Locked Button Sprite
lockedSprite.description: Button of a locked / coming soon world (game grey button, like the shop).

bubbleSprite.title: Bubble Sprite
bubbleSprite.description: Baloncuk arka plani (bos = butonun kendi sprite i).

retypeInterval.title: Retype Interval (s)
retypeInterval.description: Yazi tamamlandiktan bu kadar saniye sonra tek tek silinip yeniden yazilir (0 = tekrar yazma).

overlap.title: Overlap
overlap.description: Baloncugun butonun arkasina girdigi miktar (birlesik gorunum).

minBubbleWidth.title: Min Bubble Width
minBubbleWidth.description: Yazi bosken baloncugun gorunen genisligi (butonun disinda kalan kisim).

showDuration.title: Show Duration (s)
showDuration.description: Baloncuk bu kadar acik kalir, sonra yazi silinip kapanir.

hiddenDuration.title: Hidden Duration (s)
hiddenDuration.description: Kapandiktan sonra tekrar acilmadan once bekleme (sallanma devam eder).

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: rebirth = rebirth atilabilince; worlds = yeni dunya acilinca (gidilene kadar).

source.title: Source Entity
source.description: Morph agirliklari okunacak entity. Bos ise Source Name ile aranir.

sourceName.title: Source Name
sourceName.description: Source Entity bos ise bu isimdeki (render componentli) entity kullanilir. Ornek: W2_Stage_0_Deniz_Kopuk

model.title: Model (Rig)
model.description: Kemikli cuce modeli. Anim componenti yoksa script ekler.

areaRadius.title: Alan Yaricapi
areaRadius.description: Oyuncu cucenin evine bu mesafeden yakin olunca kovalamaya baslar (metre).

loseRadius.title: Birakma Yaricapi
loseRadius.description: Oyuncu evden bu kadar uzaklasinca cuce kovalamayi birakir.

leashRadius.title: Tasma Yaricapi
leashRadius.description: Cuce evinden en fazla bu kadar uzaklasabilir.

noticeDelay.title: Fark Etme Suresi
noticeDelay.description: Oyuncuyu gorunce kovalamaya baslamadan once bekleme (sn).

catchHeight.title: Yakalama Yuksekligi
catchHeight.description: Oyuncu cucenin ayagindan bu kadar yukaridaysa (ustunden atliyorsa) yakalanmaz.

walkAnimRefSpeed.title: Walk Anim Hizi
walkAnimRefSpeed.description: Walk animasyonu bu hizda (m/sn) 1x oynar; daha hizli yururken hizlanir.

minGroundHeight.title: Min Zemin Yuksekligi
minGroundHeight.description: Zemin bundan alcaksa (denize inen kumsal) cuce oraya girmez.

yawOffset.title: Yon Duzeltme
yawOffset.description: Model ileri yone bakmiyorsa derece olarak duzelt.

placeholder.title: Gecici Gorunum
placeholder.description: Modelde mesh yoksa basit sekillerden gecici bir cuce yapar. Gercek mesh gelince kendiliginden kapanir.

playerTilt.title: Oyuncuya Egilme (derece)
playerTilt.description: Oyuncu kenara yakin durdukca o tarafa en fazla bu kadar egilir.

playerSink.title: Oyuncu Agirligi (m)
playerSink.description: Oyuncu ustundeyken platform bu kadar batar.

waterLevel.title: Su Seviyesi
waterLevel.description: Sallanma bu yukseklikteki noktanin etrafinda olur.

moveCollider.title: Collider da Hareket Etsin
moveCollider.description: Acikken oyuncu egilen yuzeyin ustunde durur. Kapaliysa sadece gorunum oynar, collider sabit kalir.

landingSink.title: Inis Batmasi (m)
landingSink.description: Oyuncu ustune dusunce platform en fazla bu kadar batip yaylanarak geri cikar (hafif inis: %35).

inset.title: Inset
inset.description: Egimin kenardan ne kadar iceride bittigi.

run.title: Run
run.description: Egimin kenardan ne kadar disarida zemine indigi.

pointA.title: Point A
pointA.description: Rampanin bir ucunun ust orta noktasi (dunya).

pointB.title: Point B
pointB.description: Rampanin diger ucunun ust orta noktasi (dunya).

baseY.title: Base Y
baseY.description: Yan egimlerin indigi yukseklik (zeminin biraz alti).

stageRoot.title: Stage Root
stageRoot.description: Stage 5 FBX instance. Bos ise bu entity.

ballTemplate.title: Gulle (mesh)
ballTemplate.description: FBX icindeki gulle. Gizlenir, her top icin kopyasi atilir.

period.title: Ates Araligi (sn)
period.description: Her taraf bu kadar saniyede bir ates eder.

fireTime.title: Gulle Cikis Ani (sn)
fireTime.description: Ates klibinde gullenin ciktigi an (alev 0.1 sn de en buyuk).

ballTravel.title: Gulle Menzili (m)
ballTravel.description: Bu kadar gidince kaybolur (karsi gemiye carpar).

hitForgiveness.title: Tolerans (m)
hitForgiveness.description: Carpisma mesafesinden dusulur; siyirip gecmek affedilir.

cullDistance.title: Calisma Mesafesi (m)
cullDistance.description: Kamera bundan uzaksa animasyon ve gulleler durur.

sfxVolume.title: Ates Sesi (carpan)
sfxVolume.description: MonkeyObbySfx "cannon" sesinin bu sahnedeki carpani. Her yan atisinda tek ses (en yakin topa gore).

speed.title: Hiz Carpani
speed.description: 1 = klipteki hiz (4 sn de bir tur).

spokeAngles.title: Cubuk Acilari (derece)
spokeAngles.description: Kolun kendi koordinatinda atan2(x, z), virgulle. Bos ise mesh ten bulunur.

clipNode.title: Klipteki Node Adi
clipNode.description: Bos = klipte donen tek node (onerilen). Kol baska bir kolun klibini kullaniyorsa da calisir.

areaRadius.title: Alan Yaricapi (m)
areaRadius.description: Cuceye yatay uzaklik. Bunun icindeyken ates eder.

areaMinY.title: Alan Alt Siniri (y)
areaMinY.description: Oyuncu bundan asagidaysa (denize dustu) ates etmez.

fireTime.title: Ates Ani (sn)
fireTime.description: Top klibinde gullenin ciktigi an (alev 0.8 sn).

leadFactor.title: Top 2 Onden Nisan
leadFactor.description: 0 = iki top da oyuncunun yerine atar, 1 = Top 2 oyuncunun gidecegi yere.

turnSpeed.title: Donus Hizi
turnSpeed.description: Cuce ve toplarin oyuncuya donme hizi.

areaZMin.title: Alan Baslangic z
areaZMin.description: Oyuncu bu z den once ise ates etmez (baslangic / checkpoint platformu). 0 = kullanma.

areaZMax.title: Alan Bitis z
areaZMax.description: Oyuncu bu z yi gectiyse ates etmez (bitis iskelesi). 0 = kullanma.

skinFixReference.title: Skin Duzeltme Referansi
skinFixReference.description: FBX: ayni skin i paylasan meshler bu mesh in node konumuna gore bind edilmis. Bos = duzeltme yok.

skinFixTargets.title: Skin Duzeltme Hedefleri
skinFixTargets.description: Virgulle. Vertexleri (hedef node - referans node) kadar geri kaydirilir; boylece 2. top ve efektler kemiklerinin yerinde gorunur.

sfxFireVolume.title: Ates Sesi (carpan)
sfxFireVolume.description: MonkeyObbySfx "cannon". Iki top birlikte -> tek ses.

sfxBoomVolume.title: Patlama Sesi (carpan)
sfxBoomVolume.description: MonkeyObbySfx "boom". Sik gelen patlamalari yonetici birlestirir.

stageRoot.title: Stage Root
stageRoot.description: Stage 7 FBX instance. Bos ise bu entity.

minScale.title: Gorunur Olcek

searchRoot.description: Rings are searched under this entity once (Map)

ringCenter.title: Ring Center
ringCenter.description: Ring center in the ring entity's local (mesh) units

innerRadius.title: Inner Radius
innerRadius.description: Inner radius of the ring tube in local (mesh) units

edgeMargin.title: Edge Margin
edgeMargin.description: m; the player center must pass this far inside the inner radius

activeRange.title: Active Range
activeRange.description: m; rings farther than this are not checked

maxStep.title: Max Step
maxStep.description: m; a longer move in one frame is a teleport / respawn, not a pass

cooldown.title: Cooldown (s)
cooldown.description: After the panel closes, the portal waits this long (and for the player to step out) before it opens it again.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional portal mesh (render), enabled after Model Delay.

stopOnOpen.title: Stop On Open
stopOnOpen.description: Stop the board in the door when the panel opens.

extraModels.title: Extra Models
extraModels.description: Switched on together with Model (after Model Delay).

schema.name: unlockSaveKey
schema.title: Unlock Save Key
schema.description: The world is open when this save key is "1" (e.g. SkateboardObby_Completed = World 1 finished). Empty = always open.

schema.name: roomName

schema.description: Server room of this world (its NetworkManager room) for the online counter. Empty = no counter.

hereSprite.title: HERE Button Sprite
hereSprite.description: Button of the world you are in (game blue button). GO uses the template GoButton sprite.

lockedSprite.title: Locked Button Sprite
lockedSprite.description: Button of a locked / coming soon world (game grey button).

currentSceneName.title: Current Scene Name
currentSceneName.description: Empty = NetworkManager.sceneName (the same template works in every world).

soonMessage.title: Coming Soon Message
soonMessage.description: Pops on the card when a coming soon world is pressed.

onlinePath.title: Online Path
onlinePath.description: Older endpoint, used when the server answers 404 to the one above: { ccu } = players of the whole mode. Empty = only the connected room.

maxVisibleCards.title: Max Visible Cards
maxVisibleCards.description: More worlds than this scroll (the half card shows there is more).

fitMargin.title: Fit Margin
fitMargin.description: Part of the screen height the panel may use.

photoPreloadDelay.title: Photo Preload Delay (s)
photoPreloadDelay.description: Photos not loaded yet start loading this long after the scene starts. -1 = only when the panel opens.

worldsOnlinePath.title: Worlds Online Path
worldsOnlinePath.description: Server endpoint with players per room: { ccu, worlds: { <roomName>: players } }. Empty = only Online Path.

travelIcon.title: Loading Indicator
travelIcon.description: Spins on the loading screen of a world change.

pins.title: Pins
pins.description: Group entity; every child with a render is a pin (pivot at the base, local Y up)

pushFactor.title: Push Factor
pushFactor.description: Pin speed along the player velocity = player speed x this

sideSpeed.title: Side Speed (m/s)
sideSpeed.description: Sideways push away from the player path

chainFactor.title: Chain Factor
chainFactor.description: A flying pin knocks a standing pin with its own velocity x this

chainRadius.title: Chain Radius (m)
chainRadius.description: A flying pin knocks the standing pins whose center is this close (horizontal)

speedLossPerPin.title: Speed Loss Per Pin
speedLossPerPin.description: Fraction of the board speed taken by each standing pin the player hits

maxSpeedLoss.title: Max Speed Loss
maxSpeedLoss.description: At most this fraction per pass (until the pins stand up again)

fallLimit.title: Fall Limit (m)
fallLimit.description: A pin this far below its base is hidden until the reset

pinList.title: Pin List
pinList.description: Used when Pins is empty: pins that are not children of one group (World 2 lanterns).

crushSpeed.title: Crusher Hit Speed (m/s)
crushSpeed.description: A crusher moving faster than this (and near its fastest speed so far, so the slow way back does not count) and then stopping = hit sound

rollWobblePitch.title: Roll Wobble Pitch
rollWobblePitch.description: Slow drift (+-) so the rolling loop never sounds exactly the same. 0 = off

masterVolume.title: Master Volume
masterVolume.description: All Skateboard sounds. 0.5 = -6 dB, 0.7 = -3 dB, 1 = slot volumes as they are

laserRange.title: Laser Range (m)
laserRange.description: Lasers are only heard this close (the other obstacles use Hazard Range)

openDot.description: Red dot on the HUD button: rewards waiting

infoText.description: Time left of the shown set

messageText.description: Short messages, same place as the time left

rewardScale.title: Reward Scale
rewardScale.description: Multiplies every coin reward and chest (raise it if Coin Value goes up)

touchRadius.title: Checkpoint Touch Radius (m)
touchRadius.description: A checkpoint counts only if the player is this close (not tp / skip)

maxBackDays.title: Max Back Days
maxBackDays.description: The clock this far behind the saved day = broken save, roll a new set

barMinWidth.title: Bar Min Width
barMinWidth.description: The fill sprite is 9-sliced: narrower looks broken

wiggleAngle.title: Wiggle Angle
wiggleAngle.description: Degrees, HUD button while a reward waits. 0 = no wiggle

minPitch.title: Min Pitch
minPitch.description: How far the camera can look up (negative degrees). Looking up steers the climb.

defaultZoom.title: Default Zoom
defaultZoom.description: Camera distance = this + 4 (landscape) or + 8 (portrait) until the player zooms.

deathHeight.title: Death Height
deathHeight.description: The player dies below this world y.

minPitch.title: Min Pitch
minPitch.description: How far the camera can look up (negative degrees). Looking up steers the climb.

defaultZoom.title: Default Zoom
defaultZoom.description: Camera distance = this + 4 (landscape) or + 8 (portrait) until the player zooms.

offline.title: Offline
offline.description: No server connection. Turn off when the room exists on the server.

roomName.title: Room Name
roomName.description: Colyseus room name and accessToken, same as the server.

acceleration.title: Acceleration
acceleration.description: How fast the speed follows the input (1/s; 14 = about 0.07 s).

hoverHeight.title: Hover Height
hoverHeight.description: Body center above the ground (m). The body never touches a surface, the arms carry it.

groundSlack.title: Ground Slack
groundSlack.description: Counts as standing up to hover height + this (m).

hoverResponse.title: Hover Response
hoverResponse.description: Fixed gain of the hover (1/s). Stable at every frame rate; keep below 30.

settleSpeed.title: Settle Speed
settleSpeed.description: Sinking to a floor below when only floors are held (m/s).

wallDetect.title: Wall Detect
wallDetect.description: Pressing into a wall this close turns into climbing (m).

wallHold.title: Wall Hold
wallHold.description: The body keeps this far from the wall it climbs (m).

ceilingHold.title: Ceiling Hold
ceilingHold.description: The body hangs this far under a ceiling (m).

liftPitch.title: Lift Pitch
liftPitch.description: Looking up more than this (degrees) leaves the ground when a wall or ceiling is in the view.

pushOffSpeed.title: Push Off Speed
pushOffSpeed.description: Jump while holding: away from the surface (m/s).

pushOffCarry.title: Push Off Carry
pushOffCarry.description: Jump while holding: along the input (m/s).

regrabDelay.title: Regrab Delay
regrabDelay.description: Seconds after a ground jump before the arms grab again.

extraGravity.title: Extra Gravity
extraGravity.description: On top of the world gravity while falling (m/s2).

airControl.title: Air Control
airControl.description: How fast the input steers while falling (1/s).

maxGrip.title: Max Grip
maxGrip.description: Level 0 value; the level system sets this property.

gripDrain.title: Grip Drain
gripDrain.description: Per second while holding off the ground.

pushOffRegrab.title: Push Off Regrab
pushOffRegrab.description: Seconds after jumping off a surface before the arms grab again.

body.title: Body
body.description: Rotated body entity; the arms leave from its back.

armReach.title: Arm Reach
armReach.description: A planted arm lets go beyond this distance (m). The longest stretch.

armLength.title: Arm Length
armLength.description: Beyond this distance the arm is a straight line; shorter arms arc.

footSpread.title: Foot Spread
footSpread.description: Distance of a resting hand from the body, along the surface (m).

leadTime.title: Lead Time
leadTime.description: New hands land this many seconds ahead of the motion.

stepDistance.title: Step Distance
stepDistance.description: A hand farther than this steps to a new point (m).

stepBehind.title: Step Behind
stepBehind.description: A hand this far behind the motion steps (m).

minStepGap.title: Min Step Gap
minStepGap.description: Seconds between two arms lifting: they never all lift together.

raysPerFrame.title: Rays Per Frame
raysPerFrame.description: Hand target rays per frame, shared by the arms in turn.

mountHeight.title: Mount Height
mountHeight.description: Center of the back plate above the body entity (m).

mountBack.title: Mount Back
mountBack.description: Back plate behind the body entity (m).

stowRadius.title: Stow Radius
stowRadius.description: Hands wait this far from the body when there is nothing to hold (m).

cameraHideDistance.title: Camera Hide Distance
cameraHideDistance.description: Arm pieces this close to the camera are not drawn (they would cover the view).

rootRadius.title: Root Radius
rootRadius.description: Shoulders sit on a circle this big on the back plate; grows by itself when there are many arms (m).

handGap.title: Hand Gap
handGap.description: A new hand does not land closer than this to another hand (m); 3/4 of it if there is no room.

separationPasses.title: Separation Passes
separationPasses.description: Times per frame the arm curves are pushed apart. 0 = off.

bodyRadius.title: Body Radius
bodyRadius.description: Arms go around a vertical capsule this thick (m).

hookHandGap.title: Hook Hand Gap
hookHandGap.description: Distance between the two hands on a hook (m).

hookReachTime.title: Hook Reach Time
hookReachTime.description: Seconds for a hand to reach the hook.

heatStart.title: Heat Start
heatStart.description: Grip ratio where the shaking and straining start.

heatFull.title: Heat Full
heatFull.description: Grip ratio where the arms are fully red.

tremorAmplitude.title: Tremor Amplitude
tremorAmplitude.description: Shaking of the middle of the arm at grip 0 (m). The hands do not move.

strainPulse.title: Strain Pulse
strainPulse.description: Thickness wave running down the arm when fully red (share of the radius).

strainTaut.title: Strain Taut
strainTaut.description: The arm arcs this much less when fully red.

bodyShake.title: Body Shake
bodyShake.description: Shaking of the body model at grip 0 (m). The camera does not follow it.

redAt90.title: Red At 90%
redAt90.description: Redness (0..1) at 90% grip. It grows all the way from a full bar.

redAtStart.title: Red At Heat Start
redAtStart.description: Redness (0..1) when the grip reaches Heat Start.

lowRatio.title: Low Ratio
lowRatio.description: The bar turns yellow below this.

criticalRatio.title: Critical Ratio
criticalRatio.description: The bar turns red below this.

xpBase.title: XP Base
xpBase.description: XP of a step at level 0, before the speed bonus.

xpPerLevel.title: XP Per Level
xpPerLevel.description: Added to XP Base per level.

xpSpeedBonus.title: XP Speed Bonus
xpSpeedBonus.description: A step at XP Speed Ref is worth (1 + this) times the base.

xpSpeedRef.title: XP Speed Ref
xpSpeedRef.description: The bonus stops growing above this speed (m/s).

xpMinSpeed.title: XP Min Speed
xpMinSpeed.description: Steps slower than this give nothing: a player standing still does not earn XP (m/s).

levelGrowth.title: Level Growth
levelGrowth.description: Each level needs this many times the previous one.

gripPerLevel.title: Grip Per Level
gripPerLevel.description: The level 0 grip is Max Grip on the player controller.

returnDelay.title: Return Delay
returnDelay.description: Seconds between a win pad and the lobby.

saveInterval.title: Save Interval
saveInterval.description: Seconds between saves while XP changes. Level ups and wins save at once.

stages.title: Areas
stages.description: In course order. An area starts at its Start Z (world).

schema.name: line
schema.description: Second line. Empty: RECOMMENDED LEVEL x, NEEDS y GRIP.

schema.name: worldLabel
schema.description: World text that shows the recommended level.

gripHighRatio.title: Grip Green Above
gripHighRatio.description: The grip bar is green above this ratio.

gripLowRatio.title: Grip Yellow Below
gripLowRatio.description: The grip bar is yellow below this ratio.

labelInterval.title: Label Interval
labelInterval.description: Bar labels change at most this often (s). The bars themselves follow every frame.

headerTopNarrow.title: Header Top (Portrait)
headerTopNarrow.description: Under the corner buttons when the screen is narrow.

template.title: Template
template.description: A disabled text element, cloned at initialize.

poolSize.title: Pool Size
poolSize.description: At most this many at once; when all are busy a step shows nothing (the XP still counts).

maxDistance.title: Max Distance
maxDistance.description: Steps farther from the camera show nothing (m).

rewarded.title: Rewarded
rewarded.description: Asks first, then one rewarded ad. Cancel or error pays nothing.

height.title: Height
height.description: The box reaches this far above the pad (m). The body hovers 3 m up.

leaveTime.title: Leave Time
leaveTime.description: Seconds outside the box before the pad works again.

rig.title: Rig
rig.description: Rig node of the castle (bones below it).

startTime.title: Clip Start (s)
startTime.description: The clip waits before the castle falls: the hit starts it here.

material.title: Material
material.description: Deep sea material (same as the near sea).

size.title: Size (m)
size.description: Edge length. Camera farClip * 2 + a margin.

height.title: Water Y
height.description: Must stay under the wave troughs of the near sea.

holder.title: Holder
holder.description: SkateboardObby_Obstacle Target: switched on while the gate kills.

maxBarY.title: Bar Max Y (mesh units)
maxBarY.description: Only bars below this height blink, higher ones stay in the kit mesh (World 1 Stage 9: bottom rope).

glow.title: Glow Layers
glow.description: Fake glow: thin boxes around the bars, one layer per material (inner first). They blink with the bars.

pushFactor.title: Push Factor
pushFactor.description: Ball speed = rider speed along the hit * this.

upKick.title: Up Kick
upKick.description: Part of the push that lifts the ball.

fallLimit.title: Fall Limit (m)
fallLimit.description: Hidden after falling this far below its place.

solid.title: Rail Solid
solid.description: Off while the rider eases up: he rises through the bar and posts.

adOfferMaxPrice.title: Ad Offer Max Price
adOfferMaxPrice.description: Items above this coin price get no offer. 0 = no limit

adOfferExclude.title: Ad Offer Exclude
adOfferExclude.description: Item ids without an offer, comma separated (trail_rainbow,aura_star)

adTimeout.title: Ad Start Timeout
adTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for the ad to start before the button comes back

markOffset.title: Mark Offset
markOffset.description: From the center of the Shop button

wiggleHudButton.title: Wiggle Hud Button
wiggleHudButton.description: The HUD Shop button wiggles while an item is affordable, like the quest button

wiggleBuyButton.title: Wiggle Buy Button
wiggleBuyButton.description: In the Shop, the buy button of an affordable item wiggles

wigglePhase.title: Wiggle Row Phase
wigglePhase.description: Seconds between the buy buttons of two rows

glowSize.title: Glow Size
glowSize.description: Icon glow in the ad offer panel

highlightEntity.title: Highlight Entity
highlightEntity.description: Turned on while this hook is the target. Empty = a child named "Highlight".

anchorOffset.title: Anchor Offset
anchorOffset.description: Where the hands hold, local to this entity.

ropeLength.title: Arm Length
ropeLength.description: Distance held from the hook (m). 0 = Swing Controller Max Arm Length.

aimAngle.title: Aim Angle (deg)
aimAngle.description: Largest angle between the travel or camera direction and the hook.

maxRopeLength.title: Max Arm Length
maxRopeLength.description: Distance held from the hook (m), unless the hook asks for less.

reelSpeed.title: Reel Speed (m/s)
reelSpeed.description: Grabbing from far away pulls the body in at this speed.

minSwingSpeed.title: Min Swing Speed
minSwingSpeed.description: A swing never gets slower: it goes around the hook.

autoReleaseTime.title: Auto Release (s)
autoReleaseTime.description: Lets go by itself after this long. 0 = off.

swingGripDrain.title: Swing Grip Drain
swingGripDrain.description: Grip per second while on a hook.

releaseRegrab.title: Release Regrab
releaseRegrab.description: The arms do not take a wall or a floor for this long after letting go (s).

followGain.title: Follow Gain
followGain.description: How hard the rigidbody is steered back to the swing path (1/s).

alignBody.title: Align Body
alignBody.description: The body hangs from the hook.

minButtonSize.title: Min Button Size (px)
minButtonSize.description: Height of the confirm buttons in real pixels; the window grows for this.

stallTimeout.title: Stall Timeout (s)
stallTimeout.description: No asset finished for this long = the trip failed.

sectionSprite.title: Section Sprite
sectionSprite.description: Panel behind the cards. Empty = Frame Sprite.

ownScenes.title: Own Scenes
ownScenes.description: Scenes of the mode this menu is in, comma separated. Never shown as a card.

showcaseCard.title: Showcase Card
showcaseCard.description: Grid card this showcase opens (its click is reused). Works even if the card is disabled.

showcaseCrop.title: Showcase Crop
showcaseCrop.description: Usable part of the texture from its top-left: x, y, width, height (0..1). Card art has a baked frame; use 0, 0, 1, 1 for a clean picture.

showcaseFocusY.title: Showcase Focus Y
showcaseFocusY.description: Which part stays when the crop gets shorter (phone portrait banner). 0 = top, 1 = bottom.

showcaseDescription.title: Showcase Description
showcaseDescription.description: Empty = the text of the Showcase Card in Descriptions.

descriptions.title: Descriptions
descriptions.description: One line per mode: mouse hover tooltip text (English, 1-2 short sentences).

showcaseTagline.title: Showcase Tagline
showcaseTagline.description: Short line under the name. Empty = hidden. New English text: add its translations to Menu_Localization texts.

showcasePlay.title: Showcase Play
showcasePlay.description: Button text. Empty = no button. The whole showcase is the click area.

cardGap.title: Card Gap
cardGap.description: Gap between the visible pictures, as a part of the card. Smaller = bigger cards. Near 0.07 a card hovered next to a fire card touches it.

cardHover.title: Card Hover
cardHover.description: Mouse hover growth of a card.

cardMaxScale.title: Card Max Scale
cardMaxScale.description: Biggest a card can get (fire boost x hover). The side and top room of the grid is computed from it, so nothing is cut.

cardOrder.title: Card Order
cardOrder.description: Menu/Menu_CardOrder.json: the cards listed there are on, in that order. A card not listed is off. Empty = hierarchy order.

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: One line per card: grid card or Showcase + its MP4 (H.264, square).

maskSprite.title: Mask Sprite
maskSprite.description: Rounded 9-slice for the grid card corners (Menu_RoundSprite).

viewport.title: Viewport
viewport.description: Kart bunun dışına çıkınca ateş söner

boost.title: Card Boost
boost.description: Ateşli kart diğerlerinden bu kadar büyük görünür, hover bunun üstüne eklenir

video.title: Video
video.description: MP4 (H.264) in the showcase's aspect, preload off. Empty = the photo stays.

playOnTouch.title: Play On Touch
playOnTouch.description: Off: touch screens keep the photo and download nothing.

sectionSprite.title: Section Sprite
sectionSprite.description: Panel behind the cards. Empty = Frame Sprite.

eventCategory.title: Event Category
eventCategory.description: Poki category: the mode name, as in POKI_EVENTS.md (skateboard, monkey, classic).

ownScenes.title: Own Scenes
ownScenes.description: Scenes of the mode this menu is in, comma separated. Never shown as a card.

networkScript.title: Network Script
networkScript.description: Script on the NetworkManager entity, its room is left on the way out (monkeyObbyNetworkManager). Empty = no room.

saveCalls.title: Save Calls
saveCalls.description: app.<object>.<function> to call before leaving, comma separated (gameManager.saveData). A missing one is skipped. Empty = the mode saves by itself.

joinRoomName.title: Join Room Entity Name
joinRoomName.description: Cards hide while it is open, its window moves with the Menu (Classic: JoinRoomPanel).

menuFlag.title: Menu Flag
menuFlag.description: app flag that is on while the menu is open (Bike, Ball: isMenuEnabled).

hideDiscord.title: Hide Discord
hideDiscord.description: The Menu's DiscordButton sits where the column goes.

minButtonSize.title: Min Button Size (px)
minButtonSize.description: Height of the confirm buttons in real pixels; the window grows for this.

stallTimeout.title: Stall Timeout (s)
stallTimeout.description: No asset finished for this long = the trip failed.

networkEntity.title: Network Entity Name
networkEntity.description: Entity that holds Network Script (Car: Network Manager).

titleName.title: Menu Title Name
titleName.description: The title over the Menu's top edge, kept on screen (Car: Text).

iconAtlas.title: Icon Atlas
iconAtlas.description: 6 x 4 cells, cell = catalog row "cell". Loaded on demand

material.description: Palette material of the boards (same as the default board)

remoteShadows.title: Remote Shadows
remoteShadows.description: Other players' board models cast shadows

showRange.title: Show Range
showRange.description: Meters. The pickup appears inside this range, on an open stage. Players ride 25-30 m/s

holdTime.title: Hold Time
holdTime.description: Seconds to stand on it before the ad. Riding through never fills it

lookScale.title: Look Scale
lookScale.description: Monkey power-up = 1. Riders pass at 25-30 m/s here

imageSize.title: Image Size
imageSize.description: World meters. The board takes about 3/4 of the cell (a real board is 2 m)

imageHeight.title: Object Height
imageHeight.description: Center of the model / icon. Local, before Look Scale

modelLength.title: Model Length
modelLength.description: World meters (a real board is 2 m)

modelTilt.title: Model Tilt
modelTilt.description: The model stands on its tail, leaning back by this many degrees, and turns

holdTime.title: Hold Time
holdTime.description: Seconds to stand on it before the ad. Riding through never fills it

iconAtlas.title: Icon Atlas
iconAtlas.description: 6 x 4 cells, cell = catalog row "cell". Loaded on demand

leaveMargin.title: Leave Margin (m)
leaveMargin.description: The player has left the zone at Radius + this.

model.title: Model
model.description: Optional building mesh (render), enabled after Model Delay.
